findings.issue: 'Special Moonshine' is frozen as العَرَق المُعتَّق (paired with Common Moonshine = العَرَق العاديّ). عَرَق خاص is an unapproved rendering of a frozen item name.

This is a _name row - a real product title in the Steam metadata table. All fifteen sibling _name rows in this chunk keep the English title verbatim (Baldur's Gate 3, Cyberpunk 2077, Darkest Dungeon, Black Myth: Wukong...). This one alone was translated, breaking the table's own convention.

findings.source_en: This is no brigand-swill. The bottle is unopened, wrapped carefully in sackcloth by its maker. Perhaps it's meant for more than mere merriment?
findings.ar: هذا ليس خمر قطّاع طرق رخيصًا. الزجاجة لم تُفتح بعد، لفّها صانعها بعنايةٍ في قماش الكيس. ولعلّها أُعِدّت لأكثر من مجرّد المرح؟
findings.issue: 'sackcloth' is a fabric (burlap) = الخيش. قماش الكيس reads as 'the cloth of the sack', pointing at a specific bag that does not exist in the line.
findings.suggested_ar: هذا ليس خمر قطّاع طرق رخيصًا. الزجاجة لم تُفتح بعد، لفّها صانعها بعنايةٍ في الخيش. ولعلّها أُعِدّت لأكثر من مجرّد المرح؟
